opportunities.Title: Twelfth Miami Thanksgiving Camp — November 2026
opportunities.Cost: Organizer listed $199 early-bird pricing that ended October 31. Confirm the current price before registering.
opportunities.Short Description: Indoor Thanksgiving shooting and finishing camp in Kendall, Nov 23–25, 9 AM–3 PM, coed ages 3–13.
opportunities.Full Description:
Twelfth Miami lists a Thanksgiving Camp from Monday to Wednesday, November 23–25, 9 AM–3 PM, for coed players ages 3–13. It is hosted indoors at Next Level Facility, 13450 SW 129th St, Miami (Kendall), FL 33186.

The organizer describes a skills-based camp focused on footwork, ball mastery and shooting/finishing. Campers bring their own snacks and lunch, except Wednesday, when lunch is included. Confirm the current price, remaining spaces and age group with Twelfth Miami before registering.
